Name: Grave Digger
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
Use the hoe to dig the two tiles in front of each grave each day, for a chance (default 40%) to get a random artifact or a random bone item.

By default a successful dig has a 30% chance to be an artifact, which treats the tile like an artifact spot (the spots with the wiggling worms), otherwise it will be a bone item.

Bone items include any item tagged with the bon_item context tag, except those excluded in the config (by default the Bone Flute is excluded).

By default, digging has a 25% chance of spawning a ghost (thanks to Kurachi84 for the idea!).

You can use GMCM to edit the chances.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/[/url]
